name: Yitzhak Ben-Zvi
contribution: A historian, ethnologist, and Labor Zionist who was the second president of Israel from 1952 until his death in 1963.

checks.lead: Yitzhak Ben-Zvi (Hebrew: יִצְחָק בֶּן־צְבִי‎‎ Yitshak Ben-Tsvi; 24 November 1884 – 23 April 1963; born Izaak Shimshelevich) was a historian, ethnologist, and Labor Zionist who was the second president of Israel from 1952 until his death in 1963. Ben-Zvi is Israel's longest-serving president.
